purpose: Admin queue for reviewing user-submitted bug reports, feature requests and questions, with manual triage and optional GitHub forwarding.
primaryGoal: Inspect feedback evidence and safely triage individual or selected loaded rows without losing report content or source trust.

dataSources.behavior: One status/category-filtered list with limit 25 and page*25 offset, plus six independent limit:1 status/category count queries. AbortSignal is forwarded; existing query keys, keepPreviousData and inherited query policy must survive.
dataSources.backendLimits: Handler/database semantics, authorization enforcement, snapshot consistency and total accuracy not independently inspected or exercised.

dataSources.behavior: Manual status, GitHub issue URL and forwarding updates. Bulk uses validated/deduplicated IDs and Promise.allSettled over individual PATCH requests, then invalidates all feedback queries on settlement. Failed bulk preserves selection; toast owns mutation errors.
dataSources.backendLimits: No bulk backend endpoint is inferred. GitHub forwarding and partial-write behavior unverified; no mutation executed.

dataSources.behavior: Opt-in propose-only streamed advisor, scoped by feedbackId. Manual controls remain the sole persistence path. Source documents redacted envelope; server redaction and streaming behavior not runtime verified.

components.name: PageLayout
components.contract: Full-width page title/subtitle and secondary refresh action; no second workspace selector.

components.name: AdminSummary / OperationalBrief
components.contract: Typed count metrics through useOperationalMetrics; contextual description, scope and source status; preserve missing numeric values.

components.name: FeedbackFacetPanel / LayoutCard / SourceContent
components.contract: Persistent independent facet panels with combined DataState, partial KVList, skeleton, empty refresh and failure retry.

components.name: StatusDistribution / CompositionRail
components.contract: Complete status denominator only; preserve ordered categories, tiny-segment legend entries, counts, percentages and accessible summary.

components.name: CategoryMix / MetricBar
components.contract: Category-only denominator, ordered bars and count/percent readout. Existing solid fill accepts CSS variables; no new bar implementation needed.

components.name: DataTable
components.contract: Stable admin:feedback ID, persisted columns, loaded-row sort/export, named multi-selection and controlled expansion. Existing mobile adapter is opt-in and not supplied here.

components.name: FeedbackExpansion
components.contract: Body, metadata, audited masked email, conditional captured errors/console details, controlled draft URL, manual status/save/forward and propose-only AI.

components.name: BridgeStatus / badges / form and feedback primitives
components.owner: existing feedback-queue domain components and @/components/ui, @/components/feedback, @/components/motion barrels
components.contract: Visible named bridge live region; localized semantic statuses; shared Select/Input/Button, trust warning, skeleton/empty/error and preference-aware motion.

duplicatedPatterns.assessment: Local hard-coded distribution palette parallels Badge variants. Reuse existing theme-compatible presentation options; do not introduce another semantic registry.

existing: Insights stack then become three columns at xl, status spanning two.
Filter toolbar stacks then wraps at sm; pagination wraps.

issues.detail: mobileColumns hides category, page_route, reporter and github_issue_url below md. DataTable.tsx:724-725 applies hidden md:table-cell. Expansion provides reporter metadata but neither category nor page_route nor an existing issue link, so the mobile presentation does not provide equivalent access to all hidden row evidence/actions.
issues.fix: Use the existing typed DataTable mobile presentation/detail contract or enrich the existing expansion with localized category, route and existing issue navigation. Preserve all desktop columns, row selection, expansion and export scope.

issues.detail: The URL field has min-w-[260px] inside a p-4 expansion inside a padded panel and shell; report body is whitespace-pre-wrap without explicit long-token wrapping at line 52. Narrow allocated widths/long URLs can exceed available space. Actual overflow not measured.
issues.fix: Use min-w-0/w-full with responsive minimums and break-word/overflow-wrap behavior for untrusted long content; retain every field/action and explicit scroll ownership for captured logs.

accessibility.status: keyboard, screen reader, contrast, forced colors, focus and touch behavior unverified
positiveEvidence: Named localized row selection uses category/title at FeedbackQueuePage.tsx:445-450.
Bridge status is labelled role=status with aria-busy at BridgeStatus.tsx:23.
Decorative icons are aria-hidden; shared fields and native details/summary semantics reused.
CompositionRail retains text legends including visually omitted tiny fills; MetricBar uses shared reduced-motion preference.

issues.detail: Expansion buttons use generic Expand row / Collapse row despite an existing rowLabel callback; the feedback page has many expandable actionable reports. Shared labels lack the category/title differentiation already provided to selection.
issues.fix: Extend the existing DataTable expansion label branch to reuse caller rowLabel for localized Expand/Collapse {{row}} with a generic fallback; preserve keyboard Enter, aria-expanded and focus.

states.loading: List shows six skeleton lines only without retained data. Independent facet panels and summary handle their own loading.
states.empty: Facet complete zeros show explanatory refreshable empty states; table zero rows shows submission guidance.
states.error: List uses fatalError only; count panels show QueryError and retain available neighbor counts. Mutation toast supplies manual/bulk error feedback.
states.staleOffline: List StaleRefreshWarning; facets map combined stale to SourceContent retained with retry; summary labels retained measurements. Actual offline pause behavior unverified.
states.partialUnknown: Undefined counts retained as unknown; statusTotal only exists when all three finite. Facet children mount only when all counts finite. Bridge remains unknown when no list payload.

issues.detail: keepPreviousData retains prior filter/page rows during scope changes. FeedbackQueuePage reads neither isPlaceholderData nor a placeholder-specific scope indicator, and its manual/bulk row actions remain enabled apart from mutation state. useDataState accepts payload presence and does not inspect placeholder provenance. Prior-scope rows can appear under new filters without an explicit prior-scope notice.
issues.fix: Preserve keepPreviousData/query keys but distinguish placeholder rows from confirmed current-scope results using existing query flags and a source-specific retained notice; make mutation availability/scope explicit rather than silently operating on prior-filter rows.

issues.detail: The same No feedback yet / submissions will appear here message is shown for a nonempty whole queue filtered down to no matching rows; status/category filtering is not acknowledged.
issues.fix: Differentiate genuinely empty queue from no matches using active filters and known source evidence; provide clear/reset filters while preserving whole-queue insights and refresh.

issues.rule: MDC-025 unknown is not a known domain category
issues.detail: Unrecognized runtime category values are labelled Other / question through label.other, unlike StatusBadge's explicit Unknown fallback. This misrepresents a newer/unknown server enum as a recognized category.
issues.fix: Keep neutral styling but use localized Unknown and preserve original source identity where appropriate; do not recategorize wire/cache values.

visualIssues.detail: Distribution colors are hard-coded amber/emerald/slate and rose/electric-cyan/purple rather than theme tokens. The comment at lines 8-12 states MetricBar requires six-digit hex, but the inspected MetricBar now offers fill='solid' supporting CSS variables. CategoryMix omits fill and inherits gradient. This is an existing adoption gap, not a need for a new renderer.
visualIssues.fix: Adopt existing solid MetricBar fill and shared semantic/theme colors; keep category distinctions, text counts/percentages, legend order and user preferences. Remove obsolete hex-only assumption only in a future owned implementation.

visualIssues.detail: Open issue link supplies text-xs and fixed cyan-300/cyan-200 classes rather than shared typography/theme text roles. Also decorative facet icons use fixed cyan at lines 346 and 363.
visualIssues.fix: Retain native external anchor and rel/target semantics, compose current text/link tokens and typography role, and use subdued semantic icon treatment. Actual contrast remains unmeasured.

order: Preserve mobile hidden metadata/navigation and narrow expansion actions.
Make retained prior-filter scope explicit before triage.
Correct no-match and unknown category meanings.
Reuse shared expansion naming, solid bars and restrained semantic roles.

dependsOn: Existing localization catalog owner for any new canonical keys
requiredSharedChanges.acceptance: Focused named-expansion tests, no rowLabel fallback regressions, keyboard and narrow-width QA; not executed in this audit.

competingImplementations.assessment: No new table, query store, workspace selector, formatter, overlay or chart library found in root/page-specific inspected production dependencies.
FeedbackStatTile is barrel-exported but not imported by this page; no runtime adoption inferred and its source not inspected.

sectionNames: Per-row manual triage and GitHub controls
actions: Refresh list and all six facets together
Status/category filtering resets page to zero
Forward to GitHub only when enabled and not already linked
Opt-in suggest triage without automatic writes
Independent count-panel retry and list retry
dataBehavior: Status and category facets remain independent of table filters.
Status total requires every contributing finite count; category denominator excludes status counts.
Unknown values are not fabricated zero. Complete zero facets are empty, not unavailable failures.
Bulk partial failures invalidate queries and preserve operator selection.
URL draft resets only on changed persisted URL.
Email privacy/audit and AI feature/privacy boundaries remain.
No physical measurements or SI conversion introduced; counts are dimensionless and dates use existing formatter.
No second date/vehicle scope: /admin/feedback is not RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS and /admin disables vehicle control per workspaceScope.ts:23-79,97-99,178-193.
